representation_plans.learner_operation: Identify genome, capsid, optional envelope, phage attachment and injection structures, cellular absences, and relative scale.
representation_plans.text_nonvisual_equivalent: A labeled text inventory lists the components of an enveloped virion, nonenveloped virion, and head-tail bacteriophage without implying a keyed classification.

representation_plans.learner_operation: Order attachment, entry, synthesis, replication, assembly, and release and localize a blocked stage from component data.
representation_plans.text_nonvisual_equivalent: An ordered text cycle names the generalized stages and notes phage genome injection versus animal-virus entry without pathogenesis detail.

representation_plans.learner_operation: Track donor bacterial DNA through a phage and retroviral RNA through DNA synthesis to chromosomal integration.
representation_plans.text_nonvisual_equivalent: Two numbered text paths distinguish phage-mediated bacterial DNA transfer from retroviral RNA-to-DNA integration, plus a note that prions and viroids do not follow either path.

representation_plans.learner_operation: Classify an agent from nucleic acid, capsid, protein-only propagation, and host-dependent replication evidence.
representation_plans.text_nonvisual_equivalent: A three-column text comparison lists composition, capsid presence, information carrier, and propagation dependence for virus, prion, and viroid.
